subject: Re: Charformer JAX port — kickoff
body:
Closing out the window, decisions from today's review:

1) Yara's base-size multilingual run cleared the bar: +2.1 average on the low-resource script slice vs our subword baseline, roughly neutral elsewhere. That's the GBST pitch working as advertised.

2) Decision: we upstream the FLAX implementation to our open-source repo — it finally makes good on the README promise, and it's good optics for the release. Emeka owns the cleanup, two weeks.

3) Q3 sweep sizing: per Wei's memory findings we plan the sweep at checkpointing-on step-time numbers, which fits inside the budget envelope Bruno secured. Sweep plan doc due to me by May 15 so it's ready when Q3 OKRs lock June 26.

Good quarter, team.

Priya
